headline: Blocking defect confirmed: on @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 the published 1.3.4 never mounts its rail, because MountManager.currentSessionId() reads sessions.list.getSnapshot().current, a field absent from the host's SessionListState. Fail is silent (no error, no warning, config and stylesheet still injected). Differential test with the byte-identical bundle: 0 anchors without `current`, 8 anchors with it.
